faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Want to learn more about our free consultation and services? Check out our most frequently asked questions below

questions.question: How long does it take to install solar panels?
questions.answer: Installation time depends on the size of your system. Typically, installation takes 3-7 days for a medium-sized system. We also include thorough inspection and testing procedures.

questions.question: What warranty do you provide?
questions.answer: We provide a 5-year warranty on installation and engineering work. Solar panels come with a 25-30 year manufacturer's warranty. We also offer lifetime maintenance and support services.

questions.question: What is the installation cost and what are the terms?
questions.answer: The cost depends on your system size and the number of solar panels needed. We offer free site surveys and can provide accurate quotations after inspecting your property.

questions.question: Does solar panels require maintenance?
questions.answer: Solar systems require minimal maintenance, such as occasional panel cleaning. We offer affordable annual maintenance services to keep your system running efficiently.

questions.question: How much can I save on electricity costs?
questions.answer: Savings depend on your energy consumption, system size, and local weather conditions. Typically, our customers see 50-80% reduction in electricity bills based on their system design.

questions.question: Why should I choose TRP Powers Plus?
questions.answer: We have over 10 years of experience in electrical systems and solar installations. Our team consists of certified engineers and skilled technicians who provide excellent service and comprehensive after-installation support.

questions.question: Do you have portfolio examples?
questions.answer: Absolutely! We have completed over 500 projects ranging from residential homes to large commercial buildings. You can view our portfolio on our 'Portfolio' page.

calculator.assumptions: Calculated with residential progressive tariffs, Ft 0.1623 THB/kWh, 7% VAT, and average production of 120 kWh/month per 1 kWp. Actual results depend on roof direction, shade, equipment, and usage behavior.
calculator.disclaimer: This is a preliminary estimate only. A site survey and real electricity bill are required before issuing a quotation.
